7001.name: Alchemical Bomb
7001.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 18 damage; the tool is then used up.

7002.name: Frost Trap
7002.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 2 damage and inflicts Frozen for 1 turn; the tool is then used up.

7003.name: Poison Flask
7003.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 8 damage and inflicts Poisoned; afterwards that enemy takes 8 more damage at the end of each enemy turn, for 3 resolutions in total (same rule as Poison Mire); the tool is then used up.

7004.name: Piercing Trap
7004.desc: Drag it onto an empty battlefield cell to place it. When an enemy steps on it, it deals 10 damage and inflicts Rooted for 1 turn; the tool is then used up.

7005.name: Minor Health Flask
7005.desc: Tap it to use it, no dragging needed. Instantly restores 20% Health (up to max Health); the tool is then used up.

7006.name: Mana Potion
7006.desc: Tap it to use it, no dragging needed. Instantly restores 2 Cost; the tool is then used up.
